# gear-list

General equipment worth remembering the exact model of, so a replacement purchase doesn't require
guessing again.

- Truing stand: a basic tabletop unit, fine for occasional use, not a shop-grade stand
- Digital kitchen scale: 1g resolution, the single biggest upgrade to baking consistency
- Dish gauge: the tool Zbigniew showed me how to actually use correctly

Most of the specialty tools live in the garage — see [[Workshop Tools]] for where things actually
are, since "the garage" stopped being specific enough once the shelf filled up.
